01 / Exterior & Upper Level

Upper Deck & Sunset Terrace.

Our signature two-storey architectural profile pairs warm timber cladding and matte-black framing with a full-length upper sky-lounge — built for outdoor dining, sunset braais and effortless entertaining on the water.

Dual-Deck Architecture Built-In Braai & Wet Bar Full Off-Grid Solar & Lithium

Boat specifications & exterior deck

Decks & Levels 2 Full Decks

Enclosed lower residential level + covered upper sky-lounge with sunbeds, bar & dining terrace.

Outdoor Entertaining Braai & Sky-Bar

Built-in gas/wood braai station, beverage coolers, outdoor lounge seating and dimmable LED lighting.

Dimensions 16m – 24m × 6m

Heavy-duty marine pontoon hull engineered for calm stability, wrap-around walkways & rear swim platform.

Propulsion & Power Twin Outboard + Solar

Twin outboard engines (2× 115HP–250HP), helm station, bow thrusters & hybrid rooftop solar-lithium array.

Day & Overnight Capacity Sleeps 4–10 • Hosts 25+

Spacious dual-level footprint designed for zowel peaceful family stays and lively sunset gatherings.

Exterior Finishes Marine-Grade Cladding

Low-maintenance composite cedar panelling, matte-black aluminium glazing & illuminated exterior staircase.

Included Exterior & Deck Highlights

  • Covered upper canopy with recessed warm-white downlights and perimeter architectural strip lighting
  • Glass and stainless-steel balustrades for uninterrupted 360-degree water views
  • Wide wrap-around lower walkways with boarding gates and aft swim & water-sports platform
  • Integrated helm console with chartplotter, marine audio system and USB charging stations

02 / Main Deck Living

Lounge & Chef’s Galley.

Step through floor-to-ceiling sliding glass doors into a sunlit residential salon and full island kitchen — designed to bring the water views inside while keeping everyone connected.

Panoramic Sliding Glass Full Island Kitchen Seamless Indoor-Outdoor Flow

Living & kitchen specifications

Main Salon Open-Plan Lounge

L-shaped modular sofa lounge, coffee table, media wall and full-height glazing overlooking the bow deck.

Kitchen & Galley Full Chef’s Island

Fluted timber waterfall island with bar stools, stone countertops and matte-black cabinetry.

Appliances Residential-Grade

Full-size fridge/freezer, gas or induction hob, built-in oven, deep sink & optional wine cooler/dishwasher.

Indoor & Deck Dining Seats 6 – 10 Guests

Breakfast bar seating at the kitchen island plus indoor/outdoor dining table on the main or upper deck.

Included Salon & Galley Highlights

  • Slatted acoustic timber ceiling with integrated linear warm LED lighting
  • Wide-opening sliding glass doors that merge the indoor lounge with the forward waterfront deck
  • Customisable cabinetry finishes, countertop stones and flooring palettes
  • Optional climate control / air-conditioning and insulated glazing for year-round comfort

03 / Private Quarters

Custom Bedrooms.

Because every family and owner uses their boat differently, the bedroom wing is completely customisable — choose from 2 to 4 private cabins with panoramic water-level windows and signature circular portholes.

2 – 4 Custom Bedrooms King / Queen Master Suite Panoramic Water Views

How many bedrooms can you choose?

Room Count Options 2 – 4 Bedrooms

Tailor the floorplan as a spacious 2-bedroom retreat, a 3-bedroom family layout or a 4-bedroom flagship.

Master Suite King / Queen View Cabin

Private master bedroom with floor-to-ceiling lake window, reading nook, bedside tables & en-suite access.

Guest & Family Cabins 1 – 3 Guest Rooms

Configure with queen beds for couples or built-in luxury bunks for children and extended family.

Storage & Comfort Built-In Wardrobes

Full-height cabinetry, under-bed luggage storage, acoustic wall insulation & warm cove lighting.

Included Bedroom & Cabin Highlights

  • Fluted timber headboard feature wall with concealed warm indirect LED strip lighting
  • Frameless panoramic windows and signature circular marine portholes with privacy blinds
  • Acoustic wall partitioning between cabins for quiet, restful nights on the water
  • Bedside reading lamps, 220V outlets and USB-C fast charging points at every berth

04 / Bathrooms & Off-Grid Engineering

En-Suite Bathrooms.

Forget cramped marine heads. Our boat features apartment-grade bathrooms with walk-in glass rainfall showers, natural stone vanities and self-sufficient water and sanitation systems.

1 – 3 En-Suite Bathrooms Walk-In Rainfall Shower Off-Grid Water & Sanitation

Bathroom & utility specifications

Bathroom Count 1 – 3 Bathrooms

Choose private master en-suite bathrooms plus a shared guest bathroom or day-restroom.

Shower & Vanity Walk-In Glass Shower

Frameless black-trimmed shower enclosure, overhead rainfall rose, floating timber vanity & stone vessel basin.

Hot Water & Filtration Onboard Water Plant

High-capacity freshwater tanks, multi-stage UV water filtration & instant gas/solar hot water system.

Sanitation System Marine Eco-Treatment

Silent-flush ceramic toilets connected to sealed holding tanks or compliant marine waste treatment.

Included Bathroom & Off-Grid Highlights

  • Circular backlit LED vanity mirror paired with textured stone wall tiling and oak shelving
  • Full-height frosted or privacy-tinted window bringing natural daylight into the bathroom
  • Matte-black architectural tapware, heated towel rail option and recessed storage niches
  • Turnkey off-grid independence with solar generation, lithium battery bank and backup generator
